name: The Confused Jargon Coiner
effect: The altered model loses track of the question. It labels everything with made-up terms in scare quotes ("known as the 'funny' one", "Death of the Death", "Three-Point Contact", "fourth wall") and keeps interrupting itself with "Wait... no".
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
